name: Mara Quint
bio: Mara hosts and produces the Halflight podcast. Before Halflight she worked nights as a radio producer for nine years, which is how the idea started.

name: Tobiah Rendle
bio: Tobiah edits the quarterly magazine and writes the long essays. He keeps the bridge ledger quotes on an index card on his desk.

name: Ines Calder
bio: Ines writes the cover features. She has interviewed everyone on the cover so far, at the hour their shift starts.

name: Kofi Lindahl
bio: Kofi shoots every photo essay without flash, in whatever light the job has.

name: Odile Varga
bio: Odile writes the interviews and the series on shift-work families.

name: Priya Anand
bio: Priya mixes and masters every episode and records the room tone that opens each one.

name: Joel Mbeki
bio: Joel books guests, carries the recorder and logs every hour of tape.
